Rashi on Nedarim 55b:2:1.english: Chilka - Wheat that is split into two [parts].

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:2:2.english: Targis - [Wheat that is split] into three [parts].

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:2:3.hebrew: טיסני - לארבעה. ולהכי שרי, שכבר נשתנה החטה:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:2:3.english: Tisnei - [Crushed] into four [parts]. And therefore it is permitted, since the wheat has already changed.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:2:4.english: [He is] prohibited from all of them - For all of them are growths of the year.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:3:1.english: [He is] permitted [to partake] of truffles and mushrooms - Because they also grow on trees.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:3:2.english: [He is] prohibited from all of them - Because truffles and mushrooms are growths of the ground.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:2.hebrew: אומר שהכל נ"ב - מדקא חשיב בכלל שאין גידולו מן הארץ כמהין ופטריות, אלמא דלאו גידולי קרקע נינהו:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:2.english: One recites: By Whose word all things came to be - Since [the baraita] counts truffles and mushrooms among [items] whose growth is not from the ground, evidently they are not growths of the earth.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:3.hebrew: מאוירא ינקי - שאין להם שרשים בארץ, לפיכך אין מברכין עליהם כדבר שגדל מן הארץ:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:3.english: They draw sustenance from the air - For they have no roots in the ground; therefore, one does not recite a blessing over them as [over] something that grows from the ground.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:4.hebrew: והא קתני על דבר שאין גידולו מן הארץ - והיינו כמהין ופטריות, אלמא אפי' מירבא נמי לא רבו מארעא:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:4.english: And isn't it taught: Over [a food] item whose growth is not from the ground - And that [refers to] truffles and mushrooms; thus, they do not even grow from the earth.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:4:5.english: That does not draw sustenance - That is, truffles and mushrooms, for they draw sustenance from the air.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:5:1.english: Ḥamila - It is like a sheet.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:5:2.english: Wool is konam, going up [upon me], etc. - [This] implies a garment of wool.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:5:3.english: With bundles of flax - [Flax] that is beaten and not combed.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:6:1.english: [He was] loaded with wool and linen and sweated - Because of the load.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:6:2.english: And its smell was unpleasant, etc.:

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:6:3.hebrew: ואסור להפשילן לאחוריו - לעשות משוי מאותן מינין, דבענין שנצטער נדר — דהיינו לטעון ולא לכסות — ולהכי מותר לכסות:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:6:3.english: And it is prohibited to sling them behind him - [Meaning,] to make a burden of those kinds [of materials], for he vowed regarding the manner in which he was distressed — namely, to carry a load and not to cover [himself] — and therefore it is permitted to cover [himself].

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:7:1.english: Punda - A hollow belt with which one girds [oneself].

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:7:2.english: Pesakiyya - faissole [Old French for a sash or band].

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:7:4.english: Katavliya - A garment of hard leather that one wears over the iskurtiya.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:7:5.hebrew: אנפליא - הוש"ש בלע"ז, של עור:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:7:5.english: Anpilya - Hoses in Old French, [made] of leather.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:7:7.english: A tanner’s apron [kituna detzalla] - A garment of leather.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:8:1.hebrew: סגוס עבה - מין שק הוא, עבה טפי מיריעה:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:8:1.english: A thick sagos - It is a type of sackcloth, thicker than a sheet.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:8:2.english: One may go out on Shabbat - with all these things.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:8:3.hebrew: אבל לא בתיבה - שלא יכוף תיבה על ראשו ויצא, דמשוי הוי:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:8:3.english: However, not in a box - That one should not overturn a box over his head and go out [with it], for it is a burden.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:9:1.hebrew: ומותר לטעון - שלא נדר אלא ממלבוש, שהרי היה מצטער ממלבוש:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:9:1.english: And [he] is permitted to carry [a burden] - For he only vowed [to abstain] from clothing, since he was suffering discomfort from clothing.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:9:2.english: And he was sweating - From the weight of [the] burden.

Rashi on Nedarim 55b:9:3.hebrew: ואסור לטעון - שלא נדר אלא כפי שהצר לו המשוי, הילכך מותר ללבוש:
Rashi on Nedarim 55b:9:3.english: And it is prohibited to carry a burden - For he vowed only according to how the load caused him discomfort; therefore, it is permitted [for him] to wear [it].

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:2:4.english: "[He is] prohibited from all of them" - For truffles and mushrooms are included in [the category of] growths of the ground.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:4:1.hebrew: [מירבא רבו מארעא] - כמהין ופטריות ודאי מארעא רבו, ושפיר מיקרו גידולי קרקע; אבל היניקה שלהם אינה אלא מאויר קרקע, ולא מברכין "בורא פרי האדמה":
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:4:1.english: [They grow from the earth] - Truffles and mushrooms certainly grow from the earth, and they are properly called growths of the ground; however, their sustenance is only from the air of the ground, and [therefore] we do not recite [the blessing] "Who creates the fruit of the ground" [over them].

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:5:1.english: Sackcloth, a sheet, and a coarse curtain [ḥamila] - They are not garments.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:5:2.english: [He is] permitted to cover himself with wool fleece - For this [person] intended only a woven garment.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:1.hebrew: הכל לפי הנודר - פירוש: לפי ענין שהיה בשעת הנדר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:1.english: Everything is according to the one who vows - Explanation: according to the circumstance that existed at the time of the vow.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:2.hebrew: היה טעון - פירוש: מופשל לאחוריו, כדרך נושאי משאות:
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:2.english: He was bearing [a burden] - Explanation: slung behind him, in the manner of those who carry burdens.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:3.english: It is permitted [for him] to cover himself - For he intended to prohibit [it] only in the manner in which he was distressed.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:4.hebrew: רוחו קצרה - שמלבושן צר לו, אינו אסור לו אלא בלבישה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:6:4.english: His breath was short - [Meaning] that wearing them is constricting for him; he is only prohibited from wearing [them].

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:7:1.english: Punda - A hollow belt, and it is like a garment.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:7:2.english: Pesakiyya - Faisse [in Old French, a sash or band].

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:7:3.english: Anpilya - [In Old French:] calçon [i.e., a sock or stocking].

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:7:4.hebrew: כיתונא דצלא - פירוש: מלבוש עור, ויוצאין בשבת להגין מן הגשמים:
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:7:4.english: Kituna detzalla - Explanation: A leather garment, and one goes out [with it] on Shabbat to protect from the rain.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:8:1.hebrew: אבל לא בתיבה - קטנה שעל ראשו, דמשוי הוא:
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:8:1.english: However, not in a box - [a] small [one] that is on his head, for it is a burden.

Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:9:1.hebrew: והזיע - מחמת כובד משאו. וה"ה דברישא מצי למיתני פשתן, ובסיפא צמר:
Tosafot on Nedarim 55b:9:1.english: And he sweated - Because of the weight of his burden. And the same applies that in the first clause [the baraita] could have taught flax, and in the latter clause, wool:
